humanity.englishDescription: All of the people in the world.

tooth.definitionKo: (점잖게 이르는 말로) 사람이나 동물의 입안에 있으며 무엇을 물거나 음식물을 씹는 일을 하는 기관.
tooth.englishDescription: (refined) An organ in the mouth of a person or animal that bites things or chews food.
One of the fine parts that project from the shaft of a comb.

tooth.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물의 입안에 있으며 무엇을 물거나 음식물을 씹는 일을 하는 기관.
tooth.englishDescription: A part in the human or animal mouth that is used to bite something or chew food.

tooth.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 사람이나 동물의 입안에 있으며, 무엇을 물거나 씹는 데 쓰는 기관.
tooth.englishDescription: (disparaging) A part in the human or animal mouth that is used to bite or chew something.

touching.englishDescription: Feeling or being touched by something very deeply.
Felt strongly enough to cause one to take action.
A moving of the heart or spirit due to strong feelings.

touching.definitionKo: 좋은 방향으로 놀라면서 마음속 깊게 느끼다.
touching.englishDescription: Feeling strongly about something and thinking that it is admirable.

touching.definitionKo: 편지글 등에서 사연이나 내용이 매우 자세하고 정성이 지극하다.
touching.englishDescription: In a letter, etc., the story being detailed and revealing one's heart.

touching.definitionKo: 어떤 감정이나 느낌이 매우 강하게 마음에 생겨 가슴에 꽉 차는 느낌이 있다.
touching.englishDescription: Feeling that one's heart is filled with a strong emotion or sentiment.
Pitiable and pitiful enough to provoke tears.

trainee.englishDescription: A person who is in training.

trainee.definitionKo: 어떤 기술이나 지식을 익히기 위해 연습하는 사람.
trainee.englishDescription: A person who practices to learn a certain skill or knowledge.

trainee.definitionKo: 음악이나 연기, 운동 등의 분야에서, 전문적으로 활동하기 위해 특정 단체에 소속되어 연습을 하며 준비하는 사람.
trainee.englishDescription: A person who prepares to make a professional debut by practicing as a member of a certain group in the fields of music, acting, sports, etc.

trainee.definitionKo: 어느 분야에서 전문적인 기술을 가진 사람을 스승으로 섬기며 기술을 물려받기 위해 그 밑에서 일하는 사람.
trainee.englishDescription: A person who works and learns under another person with expertise in a certain professional field.
A person who pursues learning or cultivates chivalry.
A student who is being trained.

treachery.definitionKo: 믿음이나 의지, 도리를 지키지 않고 바꿈.
treachery.englishDescription: The act of abandoning one's belief, will or duty, and taking on an opposing belief, will or duty.

treachery.definitionKo: 사람들과의 관계에서 지켜야 할 믿음과 의리에 어긋나게 행동함.
treachery.englishDescription: An act or behavior against trust and loyalty that one is expected to maintain in a relationship.
The act of betraying the other side's trust and fidelity.

triumphant.definitionKo: 일이 뜻대로 되어 뽐내는 기색이 가득하다.
triumphant.englishDescription: Filled with pride because everything turned out as desired.

triumphant.definitionKo: 원하던 일을 이루어 만족스럽고 자랑스러운 마음이 얼굴에 나타난 상태이다.
triumphant.englishDescription: Having an expression on one's face that appears satisfied and proud, as one has achieved what one wanted to achieve.
Acting boastfully and with pride, as one has achieved what one wanted to achieve.

trumpet.definitionKo: 위는 가늘고 길며 끝은 넓게 퍼진 모양의, 입으로 바람을 불어 넣어 소리를 내는 금속의 관악기.
trumpet.englishDescription: A metal wind instrument, with a long, thin upper body and flaring lower end, through which one blows wind to make a sound.

trumpet.definitionKo: 폭이 좁은 원통 모양의 관으로 되어 있어 높고 날카로운 소리를 내는 금관 악기.
trumpet.englishDescription: A brass instrument that makes a high, sharp sound, which is a narrow, cylinder-shaped pipe.

uncritical.definitionKo: 옳고 그름, 좋고 나쁨을 판단하지 않는.
uncritical.englishDescription: Not judging the right or wrong, the good or bad.

unemployed.definitionKo: 직업이 없어 돈을 벌지 않고 집에서 빈둥거리는 사람.
unemployed.englishDescription: A person who idles away at home without making money because he/she is jobless.

unfamiliar.definitionKo: 전에 보거나 만난 적이 없어 모르는 사이이다.
unfamiliar.englishDescription: Having not previously encountered or seen someone, and thus not knowing him/her.

unfamiliar.definitionKo: 전에 보거나 듣거나 경험한 적이 없어 익숙하지가 않다.
unfamiliar.englishDescription: Having not previously seen, heard of, or experienced something, and thus being not familiar with it.

unfamiliar.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 익숙하지 않아 어색하고 낯설다.
unfamiliar.englishDescription: Something seeming awkward and strange because one is not accustomed to it.

unfamiliar.definitionKo: 자주 보거나 듣지 않아 익숙하지 않다.
unfamiliar.englishDescription: Not accustomed to something because one has barely seen or heard about it.

unfamiliar.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이 익숙하지 못하고 낯이 설다.
unfamiliar.englishDescription: Not accustomed to or familiar with something.
Inexperienced in and not accusomed to something.

unfolding.englishDescription: The act of details being laid out and unfolding.
The act of spreading out in width or length.

unrivaled.definitionKo: 어떤 분야에서 남이 따를 수 없을 정도로 뛰어난.
unrivaled.englishDescription: Supreme in a certain area with no equal.

unrivaled.definitionKo: 어떤 분야에서 남이 따를 수 없을 정도로 뛰어난 것.
unrivaled.englishDescription: A supreme work in a certain area with no equal.

unseal.definitionKo: 함부로 열지 못하게 단단히 붙이거나 싸 두었던 물건을 열다.
unseal.englishDescription: To open something wrapped or sealed tightly to protect or conceal it.
To take out and use an object stored.

vegetable.definitionKo: 밭에서 기르며 주로 그 잎이나 줄기, 열매를 먹는 농작물.
vegetable.englishDescription: A plant grown in a field, of which the leaves, stems, or fruits are edible.

vegetable.definitionKo: 밭에서 기르며 주로 그 잎이나 줄기, 열매를 먹는 농작물.
vegetable.englishDescription: A plant cultivated in the field, whose leaves, stems, or fruits are mostly edible.

vegetables.definitionKo: 사람이 가꾸거나 저절로 자라난 온갖 채소와 나물.
vegetables.englishDescription: Various vegetables and herbs, grown by people or growing by themselves.

vice-principal.definitionKo: 학교에서 교장을 도와 학교 일을 관리하거나 지휘하는 직위, 또는 그러한 일을 하는 사람.
vice-principal.englishDescription: A position of assisting the principal in managing or supervising school work, or the person with such a position.

video.englishDescription: A moving picture often watched on the computer.
The image in contrast to the sound of a television.

video.definitionKo: 비디오테이프에 들어 있는 영상과 소리를 재생하거나 새로운 영상과 소리를 비디오테이프에 기록하는 장치.
video.englishDescription: A device for playing the images and sounds contained in a videotape or recording new images and sounds on a videotape.

video.definitionKo: 영화나 텔레비전 등의 화면을 통해 전달되는 작품.
video.englishDescription: A product delivered through the screen of a movie theater, TV, etc.

video.definitionKo: 텔레비전, 컴퓨터, 휴대 전화 등의 화면에 나타나는 모양.
video.englishDescription: The appearance on the screen of a television, computer, mobile phone, etc.

violet.englishDescription: A mixed color of red and blue.
A mixed color of red and blue.
The color produced by blending blue and red.

violet.definitionKo: 봄에 들에서 피는, 한 뼘 정도 되는 꽃줄기에 다섯 장의 꽃잎이 달리는 보라색 꽃.
violet.englishDescription: A purple flower that has five petals on its stem about the length of a hand span and blossoms in spring fields.

virginity.definitionKo: 이성과 육체적인 관계가 없음. 또는 그런 상태.
virginity.englishDescription: The state of having no sexual relations with the opposite sex, or such a state.
The state of remaining a virgin in a male-female relationship.
The sexual purity that one has as a virgin.

voting.definitionKo: 투표에서 찬성표를 얻음. 또는 얻은 찬성표.
voting.englishDescription: The act of receiving approval votes in an election, or such a vote.
An act of making a decision with a vote.

warrior.definitionKo: 무술을 배우고 익혀 그것을 쓰는 일을 하는 사람.
warrior.englishDescription: A person who learns martial arts and practices it as a job.

wasteland.definitionKo: 식물이 자라지 못하는 거칠고 메마른 땅.
wasteland.englishDescription: A barren and dry land where plants cannot live.

wasteland.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 아무런 개발이나 발전이 되지 않은 곳. 또는 그런 상태.
wasteland.englishDescription: (figurative) A place that has not been developed or cultivated, or such a state.

wasteland.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 매우 어지럽거나 못 쓰게 된 모양.
wasteland.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which an area has become disordered or useless.

wasteland.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 매우 어지럽거나 못 쓰게 된 모양.
wasteland.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which an area has become disordered or useless.

wasteland.definitionKo: 가꾸지 않고 내버려 두어 거친 땅.
wasteland.englishDescription: A barren and dry land that is left uncultivated.
A barren land that is left uncultivated.

wickedness.englishDescription: A state of being capricious, clever or cunning.
One's state of mind being sly and cruel, different from what one appears to be.

wickedness.definitionKo: 사람으로서 마땅히 해야 할 도리에 어긋나고 성질이 악함.
wickedness.englishDescription: One's tendency to do things against the morality that a person should have; and one's personality being bad.
A quality of being evil and violent.
A quality of being extremely evil and violent.

wineglass.englishDescription: A vessel from which alcohol is drunk.

woodpile.definitionKo: 자른 나무를 많이 모아 한 곳에 쌓아 올린 것.
woodpile.englishDescription: A stack of firewood cut and gathered in one spot.

word.definitionKo: 다른 곳에 있는 사람에게 소식을 전함. 또는 그 소식.
word.englishDescription: The act of delivering news to someone in another place; or such news.

word.definitionKo: 의미와 소리, 기능을 가져 홀로 사용될 수 있는 가장 작은 말의 단위.
word.englishDescription: The smallest independent unit of speech, which can be used alone, with a meaning, sound, and function of its own.

word.definitionKo: 일정한 뜻과 기능을 가지며 홀로 쓰일 수 있는 가장 작은 말의 단위.
word.englishDescription: The smallest independent unit of language, which has a certain meaning or function.

write.englishDescription: To make a script, document, etc.
To write certain facts in a document, etc.

write.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 정해진 문서나 노트 등에 쓰다.
write.englishDescription: To write certain facts in a document, note, etc.

write.definitionKo: 글을 쓰거나 정리하여 한 권으로 묶다.
write.englishDescription: To write or edit pieces of writing and publish them in a book.
To compose a piece of writing or song.
To fill in something on something.
To issue a check, promissory note, document, etc.

write.definitionKo: 연필이나 펜 등의 필기도구로 종이 등에 획을 그어서 일정한 글자를 적다.
write.englishDescription: To write some letters by drawing strokes on paper with a writing instrument such as a pencil, pen, etc.

write.definitionKo: 머릿속의 생각이나 느낌 등을 종이 등에 글로 적어 나타내다.
write.englishDescription: To express one's thoughts, feelings, etc., by writing them on paper, etc.

write.definitionKo: 원서나 계약서 등의 일정한 양식을 갖춘 문서를 작성하다.
write.englishDescription: To draw up a document of a certain form such as an application, contract, etc.

write.definitionKo: 머릿속에 떠오른 노래를 악보에 음표로 나타내다.
write.englishDescription: To write notes of a song that has come across one's mind on a musical note.

write.definitionKo: 시, 소설, 편지, 노래 가사 등의 글을 쓰다.
write.englishDescription: To write a poem, novel, letter, song, etc.
To do bookkeeping or write a diary, etc.

write.definitionKo: 주로 학술적인 글이나 책 등을 쓰다.
write.englishDescription: To write mainly academic articles, books, etc.
To write down words or letters.
To express something by writing it down.

wrong.englishDescription: A certain thing or act being not right.
The state of not being right.

wrong.definitionKo: 생각이나 행동, 태도가 바르지 못하고 못되다.
wrong.englishDescription: One's mentality, behavior, and attitude being malicious, not right.

wrong.definitionKo: 생각이나 행동, 태도가 바르지 못하고 못되다.
wrong.englishDescription: One's mentality, behavior, and attitude being malicious and inappropriate.

zzz.definitionKo: 잠이 들어 고르게 숨 쉬는 소리.
zzz.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of breathing regularly while being asleep.

zzz.definitionKo: 깊이 잠들어서 숨을 크게 쉬는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
zzz.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound made when one makes a loud, breathing sound in deep sleep, or describing such a scene.

zzz.definitionKo: 깊이 자면서 숨을 쉬는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
zzz.englishDescription: A word imitating a breathing sound in deep sleep, or describing such a scene.
